d:
When you've spent years together, you might think you've seen it all and know everything about each other. But does that mean there are no surprises left?
Sometimes, it's the little unexpected things that remind us how much we still have to learn about the person we love. With the children grown up and a little more time for themselves, there's a chance to discover new ways to make each other feel special. And sometimes, a diamond solitaire can be the perfect surprise to mark a love that only grows stronger with time.
Love so real, only a real diamond will do.
